summary: John's great-granduncle; WWII-era military service (1945, probable).
bio:
b. 25 Aug 1913; married Genevieve Schwab in 1937; military service 1945 (FS tree, probable); d. 12 Aug 2000; buried at St. Mary of Mt Carmel, Dunmore.

In April 1940 Nicholas, his wife Genevieve and their baby daughter Grace rented a unit in the family house at 1028 Bunker Hill Street ([R4-S1]). As 'Nick Petrillo' he was a surviving brother of Josephine Castellano in November 1995 ([R4-S2]).
sources: [R4-S1] 1940 US census, Scranton Ward 10, Lackawanna Co., PA, ED 71-64, sheet 4B (enumerated 20 Apr 1940), Bunker Hill Street nos. 1020-1028: households of James 'Petranello' (28), Nicholas 'Petranello' (29), Charles 'Petranello' (33), DiBiasi (1022) and Genello (1020).
